paragraphs: Yosef bar Chanin. He asked Rabbi Abbahu a question, recorded in [Shabbat 116a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.116a.10).[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: Hyman’s text has קטו., 115a. The linked passage at 116a names Yosef bar Chanin and Rabbi Abbahu.
בעי מר׳ means “he asked Rabbi” or “he made an inquiry of Rabbi,” with Yosef as the subject.
Yosef asks Rabbi Abbahu whether the books of Bei Avidan may be rescued from a fire. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2015&lang=en) cites this exchange at 116a.
